turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You are not finished with it, O-lan, and you will live to see our son married and our family prosperous.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry, I will take care of Father and the household, and I will make sure to find a good wife for myself soon.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You will not speak of dying, O-lan. You will rest and recover, and I will take care of everything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have done all I can, Wang Lung. The boy will soon be a man, and I must see him settled before I go.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will find a good wife soon, Mother, and she will take care of Father and the household, just like you have done.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You must not think of leaving us, O-lan. You are not finished with life yet, and I need you here with me.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have lived for the family, and now it is time for the boy to take his turn. I will not trouble you all with my illness much longer.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: We will not think of settling the boy's marriage now. You must concentrate on your health, O-lan, and let us worry about the future.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have seen many seasons come and go, and I know that life is fleeting. The boy must be married and have children of his own, for the family's future is at stake.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will do exactly as you wish, Mother. I promise to find a good wife and start a family soon.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: You will not trouble yourself with such thoughts, O-lan. You must rest and let us take care of the arrangements for the boy's marriage.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not be a burden to you, Wang Lung. The boy's marriage is a matter of great importance, and I will not see it delayed by my own decline.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I will not let you worry about this, Mother. I will take care of everything and find a good wife soon, you can rest easy.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not speak of such things. Your thoughts are clouded by illness and you are not thinking clearly.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not rest easy until the boy is married and settled, Wang Lung. His future is secure, and that is all that matters to me.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Please, Mother, do not tire yourself further. I will find a good wife as soon as possible, and we will make sure that everything is done just as you wish.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I, um, I could bring a bowl of tea, Mother, if it would help you feel better?

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not think of the future, my love. Your thoughts are consumed by this illness, and I will not have you worrying about the boy's marriage on top of your own suffering.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: But, Wang Lung, it is not just about me, or the boy's marriage. It is about the future of our family, and the legacy we leave behind.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must promise me that you will not exhaust yourself on this. I will find a suitable wife for the boy, and you can rest easy knowing that his future is secure.
